title: Real-account storage smoke drives a facade round-trip against a real DO namespace
asA: operator validating platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 against a real Cloudflare account
iWant: the real-account-storage-smoke probe to open the facade against a real DO namespace, drive a storage round-trip with the elicited backend and assert the round-trip returns
soThat: the shipped DO facade surface is proven against the vendor's runtime, not only against the in-process driver

acceptanceCriteria.description: The real-account-storage-smoke probe, when CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true and the paired CF_ACCOUNT_ID / CF_DO_NAMESPACE_ID / CF_API_TOKEN env vars are set, opens the facade against the real Cloudflare account with a real DO namespace, drives a storage.put("k","v")->get("k")==="v" round-trip and returns aggregateVerdict: pass. Without CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT the probe records accountBoundSkipped: true and aggregates to pass per spec section 3.5.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real Cloudflare account with the paired env vars, or no such account and CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT unset
acceptanceCriteria.then: with the account: the round-trip returns and the probe passes. Without the account: accountBoundSkipped:true and exit 0.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bounded-wait: the real-account probe caps its round-trip attempts at 30 seconds. If the storage.put or storage.get calls do not settle within the cap, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" with reason CF_DO_ROUND_TRIP_TIMEOUT and the observed elapsed millis.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real-account probe whose CF API calls hang past 30 seconds
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" with reason CF_DO_ROUND_TRIP_TIMEOUT and elapsed millis

acceptanceCriteria.description: Partial env-var configuration: with CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true but CF_API_TOKEN missing, the probe refuses before any API call with a named error kind CF_MISSING_TOKEN naming the missing variable. Same for CF_ACCOUNT_ID or CF_DO_NAMESPACE_ID.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe refuses with CF_MISSING_TOKEN naming the missing variable

acceptanceCriteria.description: Non-2xx API response: if the Cloudflare API returns a 401, 403 or 5xx during the round-trip, the probe surfaces the observed HTTP status and response body, and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" with reason CF_DO_HTTP_ERROR. 4xx is not retried; 5xx retries once.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a real-account probe where the DO API returns 403
acceptanceCriteria.then: aggregateVerdict is "fail" with reason CF_DO_HTTP_ERROR, HTTP status and body
